As Sanofi (SNY) Shares Declined, Senzar Asset Management Boosted Position by $8.50 Million; Apple (AAPL) Stock Value Declined While Meritage Portfolio Management Has Lifted Stake
April 25, 2018 - By Hazel Jackson
Senzar Asset Management Llc increased its stake in Sanofi (SNY) by 25.37% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Senzar Asset Management Llc bought 202,300 shares as the company’s stock declined 8.41% with the market. The hedge fund held 999,786 shares of the major pharmaceuticals company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $42.99M, up from 797,486 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Senzar Asset Management Llc who had been investing in Sanofi for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $100.84 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.84% or $0.335 during the last trading session, reaching $40.085. About 1.04 million shares traded. Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) has declined 13.31% since April 25, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 24.86% the S&P500.
Meritage Portfolio Management increased its stake in Apple Inc (AAPL) by 10.08% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Meritage Portfolio Management bought 17,430 shares as the company’s stock declined 3.81% with the market. The institutional investor held 190,406 shares of the computer manufacturing company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $32.22 million, up from 172,976 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Meritage Portfolio Management who had been investing in Apple Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $834.37B market cap company. The stock increased 0.92% or $1.5 during the last trading session, reaching $164.44. About 22.36M shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 19.49% since April 25, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 7.94% the S&P500.
Among 12 analysts covering Sanofi-aventis Sa ( NYSE:SNY ), 1 have Buy rating, 2 Sell and 9 Hold. Therefore 8% are positive. Sanofi-aventis Sa had 25 analyst reports since October 15, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The stock has “Hold” rating by Bernstein on Thursday, February 8. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, September 5 by Cowen & Co. JP Morgan maintained the shares of SNY in report on Friday, March 31 with “Sell” rating. The stock of Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) has “Overweight” rating given on Thursday, October 15 by Morgan Stanley. The firm has “Hold” rating given on Tuesday, May 3 by HSBC. As per Monday, December 18, the company rating was maintained by Cowen & Co. Argus Research initiated Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) on Thursday, April 6 with “Buy” rating. Barclays Capital upgraded Sanofi (NYSE:SNY) on Thursday, May 12 to “Overweight” rating. As per Monday, November 9, the company rating was downgraded by Bernstein. The firm earned “Neutral” rating on Tuesday, September 13 by BNP Paribas.
Senzar Asset Management Llc, which manages about $442.00M and $391.71M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Allergan Plc by 11,200 shares to 48,900 shares, valued at $8.00 million in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Halozyme Therapeutics Inc (NASDAQ:HALO) by 3.29 million shares in the quarter, leaving it with 537,500 shares, and cut its stake in Healthsouth Corp (NYSE:HLS).
Among 54 analysts covering Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 35 have Buy rating, 1 Sell and 18 Hold. Therefore 65% are positive. Apple Inc. had 401 analyst reports since July 21, 2015 according to SRatingsIntel. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Monday, March 5 by Bank of America. FBR Capital maintained the shares of AAPL in report on Friday, August 7 with “Buy” rating. Piper Jaffray maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Friday, January 12. Piper Jaffray has “Buy” rating and $200.0 target. The stock has “Buy” rating by Piper Jaffray on Friday, September 11. The firm has “Outperform” rating given on Wednesday, July 27 by Raymond James. Barclays Capital maintained Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) rating on Friday, July 15. Barclays Capital has “Overweight” rating and $115 target. As per Tuesday, August 11, the company rating was maintained by Oppenheimer. On Wednesday, April 27 the stock rating was maintained by Morgan Stanley with “Overweight”. The stock has “Buy” rating by Needham on Tuesday, June 6. The rating was upgraded by Pacific Crest to “Overweight” on Wednesday, October 28.
Meritage Portfolio Management, which manages about $1.31B and $1.04 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Mastercard Inc (NYSE:MA) by 2,690 shares to 159,285 shares, valued at $24.11M in 2017Q4, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Ishares Russell 1000 Growth (IWF) by 4,606 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 35,380 shares, and cut its stake in Chevron Corp (NYSE:CVX).
